recognize_zh: 皮膚切片中真皮全層被中至大型、核不規則且有細緻核摺痕的非黏著性單形細胞浸潤，於膠原纖維間呈單列穿插，表皮下保留一條無浸潤帶（grenz zone）；免疫染色 NPM1 呈細胞質異位表現，NGS 見 NPM1 4 鹼基插入，符合 NPM1 突變的骨髓肉瘤。
features: Dense diffuse dermal infiltrate extending through the full biopsy depth, with a narrow uninvolved subepidermal zone (grenz zone)
Discohesive intermediate to large cells dissecting between collagen bundles, singly and in cords
Irregular, folded or indented nuclei with fine chromatin, some with small distinct nucleoli; moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm
Immunostains show diffuse strong positivity in the infiltrate (membranous and cytoplasmic patterns) with a partial granular histiocytic-marker pattern
NPM1 immunostain with cytoplasmic as well as nuclear staining (aberrant cytoplasmic localization)
NGS read alignment (IGV) showing a 4-base (TAGG) insertion in NPM1 exon 12 at the W288 codon
describe_en: Skin punch biopsy shows a dense, diffuse dermal infiltrate occupying the full thickness of the specimen with sparing of a narrow subepidermal zone. The infiltrate consists of discohesive intermediate to large cells that dissect between collagen bundles and have irregular, folded nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm; epidermotropism is not seen. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse expression of the illustrated markers, reported as CD4, CD56, CD33, lysozyme, CD68 and partial CD163, with negative B-, T-cell, CD34, CD117, MPO, CD123 and TCL1 (individual panels are not labeled), and NPM1 shows aberrant cytoplasmic localization. Next-generation sequencing shows a 4-base insertion in NPM1 exon 12. Findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma with monocytic differentiation and NPM1 mutation (leukemia cutis).

ddx.vs: BPDCN is also CD4+/CD56+ and dermal with grenz zone, but it expresses CD123, TCL1 and TCF4 and lacks lysozyme/CD68 monocytic markers and cytoplasmic NPM1, which are the reverse of this case.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or blastoid mantle cell lymphoma involving skin
ddx.vs: These can look identical on H&E but express CD20/PAX5 (and cyclin D1 in MCL) and are negative for lysozyme, CD33 and cytoplasmic NPM1.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous extranodal NK/T-cell or peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: T/NK lymphomas show CD3, cytotoxic markers or EBER positivity and often angiocentric necrosis, whereas this infiltrate lacks T-cell markers and shows myelomonocytic antigens.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin, nuclear molding and CK20 dot-like and neuroendocrine marker positivity, and lacks CD45 and myeloid markers.

Immunostains (unlabeled panels A-D) showing diffuse positivity of the infiltrate
